plans.idea: Faithful split like the original: logo top-left, then a left text column (headline, then copy) with the Taste the Glow pill under it on the same left edge, and the bottle filling the right column at full height so the order runs brand, message, action, with the product as the counterweight.

Product-first mirror: the bottle anchors the left column at full height, and the right column stacks logo, then headline and copy, then the pill on one shared left edge, so the eye moves from product to brand to message to action.

Two tiers: a centred logo and a full-width headline band across the top, so the copy wraps into fewer lines at a larger size, then a lower row that pairs the bottle on the left with the pill and fine print grouped on the right.
